concept_name: Coastal Expedition 150 — high-efficiency coastal passenger ship

mission.mission_statement: A frequent-stop coastal passenger ship with an intimate expedition experience and optional community logistics, designed around minimum whole-voyage energy and zero direct combustion at berth where infrastructure supports it.
mission.operating_region: Illustrative northern/coastal route; no actual itinerary adopted as the final design basis.
mission.route_profile: Working comparator: approximately 12-day operation with many short port calls, explicitly inspired by public coastal service profiles but not claimed as an exact replica.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Provisional schedule speed for trade studies; must be solved against route timetable and energy.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Actual route track, weather contingency, energy reserve and charging availability must be defined.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: A provisional voyage duration for route/port energy studies.

port_calls.rationale: A stress-test count for frequent port calls, not a selected itinerary.

length_overall_m.rationale: Concept envelope aligned to a coastal cruise scale; detailed geometry not selected.

beam_m.rationale: Set from stability, passenger decks, resistance, port envelope and layout.

design_draft_m.rationale: Needs route bathymetry, under-keel clearance, propulsor and loading analysis.

air_draft_m.rationale: Especially sensitive to retractable wing rigs, bridges, terminal access and emergency operations.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Must come from a compartment, system, outfit and margin mass ledger.

guest_capacity.rationale: Working passenger capacity for the first comparison tier.

crew_capacity.rationale: Determine through service, manning, hotel, lifesaving and crew-workload studies.

vehicle_or_cargo_capacity.rationale: Retain optional logistics capability only if the mission and structural layout justify it.

operating_profile.sea_state_envelope: Define a real coastal route corpus with seasonal weather, wave/current exposure, port closures and refuge options.
operating_profile.weather_routing: Optimise speed and route under hard arrival-time, passenger comfort, sea-state and minimum-reserve constraints.
operating_profile.speed_policy: Compare schedule-preserving speed with arrival-window flexibility; quantify the energy cost of punctuality.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional schedule availability target; must be reconciled with weather and maintenance assumptions.

energy_architecture.distribution_architecture: Compare a zonal ship-wide electric architecture with segregated essential buses, battery buffering and a safe independent emergency-power strategy.
propulsion_candidates: shore-charged battery-dominant hybrid if full route closure is proved
dispatchable hybrid-electric architecture with future-fuel options
energy_carriers_to_evaluate: e-methanol or bio-methanol with pathway and hazard accounting
hydrogen fuel-cell variant as a bounded feasibility study

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Do not assume Sea Zero's published 73 MWh fits this different design; size from power, range, port dwell, reserve, battery mass and charging envelope.

energy_architecture.shore_power: Model each port's power, connection time, tariff, grid carbon intensity and availability; charge scheduling is part of itinerary design.
energy_architecture.wind_assist: Trade study retractable wing rigs against wind statistics, air draft, stability, passenger egress, lifeboat envelopes and port restrictions.
energy_architecture.solar_assist: Evaluate actual panel area, shading, orientation, salt/fouling maintenance and seasonal irradiance; use as an incremental contribution.
energy_architecture.thermal_integration: Treat HVAC, hot water, refrigeration, galley, laundry and pools as a first-class hotel-load and heat-recovery network.

propulsion_kw.rationale: Calculate from candidate resistance/propulsor maps and operating-speed distribution.

hotel_kw.rationale: Establish occupancy- and time-resolved passenger/hotel services loads.

hvac_kw.rationale: Climate, comfort, ventilation, envelope and cabin-use profile required.

freshwater_kw.rationale: Potable water, wastewater and storage schedule required.

waste_treatment_kw.rationale: MARPOL/route constraints and treatment train required.

galley_kw.rationale: Dining-service schedule, refrigeration and kitchen appliances required.

port_mode_kw.rationale: Berthing hotel load and simultaneous charging are to be measured or calculated separately.

load_budget.basis: Build a mode-resolved 15-minute or finer load profile for sea, arrival, shore charge, port stay, peak service and emergency modes; no energy balance yet.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Compare with an equivalent capacity, itinerary, stop schedule, service level and weather distribution.
performance_targets.validation_method: Lifecycle fuel/electricity factors plus verified voyage-energy model; eventually validate on a held-out route.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Only for ports with confirmed shore power or other verified zero-direct-emission supply.
performance_targets.validation_method: Port inventory, shore connection simulation and operational telemetry.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Same passenger capacity, hotel services, route, stops and arrival windows.
performance_targets.validation_method: Independent propulsion and hotel-load accounting; model basin tests and voyage measurements.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: All mandatory route, stability, safety, environmental and energy constraints under uncertainty.
performance_targets.validation_method: Adversarial feasibility suite; no single environmental or cost score can offset a failed hard gate.

hard_constraints.description: Applicable international passenger-ship safety obligations for the intended route and operating category.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Flag/class review and a traceable SOLAS applicability/compliance matrix.

hard_constraints.description: Evacuation, muster, lifeboat/rescue arrangement, accessibility and passenger flow for declared maximum persons.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Timed evacuation/egress analyses and prescribed testing/review.

hard_constraints.description: Intact/damage stability, loading conditions, free surface and high-mounted wind-assist loads.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Qualified stability analyses and applicable class/flag review.

hard_constraints.description: Energy storage and fuel-specific fire, smoke, ventilation, containment and emergency isolation.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Hazard analysis, compartment strategy and applicable approval.

hard_constraints.description: Sewage, garbage, bilge, emissions and other pollution controls for routes and ports.
Draft, air draft, berth geometry, charging time/power and terminal capacity across every intended stop.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Verified route/port geospatial and infrastructure dataset.

assumptions.statement: Hotel-load and HVAC optimization can be as material as propulsion efficiency for a passenger ship.
assumptions.falsification_method: Measure or model mode-resolved electric, heating/cooling, refrigeration and water loads; report uncertainty by service mode.

assumptions.statement: Frequent port calls may create enough shore-charging opportunities to change the feasible energy architecture.
assumptions.falsification_method: Simulate each port dwell, power limit, connection reliability, route delay and seasonal grid factor.

assumptions.statement: Wind-assist and hull/propulsor improvements can compound without invalidating each other's benefit estimates.
assumptions.falsification_method: Run coupled rather than additive sub-system estimates and validate with model tests; quantify interaction effects.

provenance.title: Hurtigruten Sea Zero project page
provenance.scope: Project-specific reported concept features, R&D and energy-reduction claims; comparator anchor only, not independent in-service data.

provenance.title: IMO SDC 12 ship-design and construction workplan
provenance.scope: Published workplan milestones for safety frameworks concerning selected energy-transition technologies; must re-check before approval.

provenance.title: IMO passenger ship safety and environmental standards
provenance.scope: Public overview of applicable passenger-ship safety and MARPOL requirements; not a compliance checklist.

provenance.title: ITTC Practical Guidelines for Ship CFD Applications
provenance.scope: Reference for ship CFD verification, validation, uncertainty and applicability; exact test data/use rights must be checked.

claim_ceiling: Concept hypothesis only. Sea Zero is a project-specific public comparator, not a validated design basis for this vessel. No range, battery size, emissions, energy saving, safety or class result is established.
